name: Boku-tachi o Tsunagu Mono
source:
The protagonist Atsushi has got to go to a festival with 
the daughter of a great family Ayame. As he spends time 
with her he comes to know a trouble that she has.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233687.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公敦志必须和名门千金绫女一起参加祭典。与她相处的过程中，他得知了她的烦恼。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE233687.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
